question: Can price/OI joint states create a standalone BTC 5m edge after price-only standalone rules failed?

data.metrics: checksummed Binance daily 5m metrics archives, continuous 2020-09-01 through 2025-12-31

causality.lastAllowedMetric: metric event timestamp at or before the closed bar open timestamp, intentionally one bar stale

bias: existing causal 1h EMA50/EMA200 direction must agree with 4h EMA20 slope

families.POSITION_BACKED_CONTINUATION: 1h price move in bias direction >= 1 ATR5, OI change1h positive above threshold, geometric taker ratio confirms direction
families.LONG_LIQUIDATION_RECLAIM: LONG bias, 1h price move <= -1 ATR5, OI change1h below negative threshold, taker ratio < 1, current closed 5m bullish and closes above prior 5m high

discoveryGate: within a family, at least 3 of 4 configs need >=30 trades, net return >0, profit factor >1, and drop-top-20% net return >0
representative: qualifying config closest to family median net return; tie prefers 0.5% OI threshold then TP1.5
oosGate: representative and immediate parameter neighbors remain net positive
safety: Research only; no server edit, arming, deploy, order, or position action.
